title: SM ST6C
text: 带自动电压调节器的离散时间或连续时间同步电机 ST6C 静态励磁系统，输入 10 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} 指定初始输出电压、{Initial terminal voltage, Vt0 (pu)} 指定初始机端电压、{Initial terminal current, It0 (pu)} 指定初始机端电流、{Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} 指定补偿电阻、{Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} 指定补偿电抗、{Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Voltage regulator proportional gain, K_PA (pu)} 调节器比例增益、{Voltage regulator integral gain, K_IA (pu/s)} 调节器积分增益、{Pre-control gain constant of the inner loop field voltage regulator, K_FF (pu)} 指定内环励磁电压调节器的预控制增益常数、{Forward gain of inner loop field regulator, K_M (pu)} 指定内环励磁调节器的前向增益、{Feedback gain constant of the inner loop field voltage regulator, K_G (pu)} 指定内环励磁电压调节器的反馈增益常数、{Feedback time constant of inner loop field voltage regulator, T_G (s)} 指定内环励磁电压调节器的反馈时间常数、{Maximum voltage regulator output, V_Amax (pu)} 指定电压调节器最大输出、{Minimum voltage regulator output, V_Amin (pu)} 指定电压调节器最小输出、{Maximum regulator output limit, V_Rmax (pu)} 调节器最大输出、{Minimum regulator output limit, V_Rmin (pu)} 调节器最小输出、{Maximum rectifier output limit, V_Mmax (pu)} 指定整流器最大输出、{Minimum rectifier output limit, V_Mmin (pu)} 指定整流器最小输出、{Thyristor bridge firing control equivalent time constant, T_A (s)} 指定晶闸管桥触发控制的等效时间常数、{Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} 指定 OEL 输入位置、{Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} 指定 UEL 输入位置、{Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} 指定 SCL 输入位置、{Exciter output current limiter gain, K_LR (pu)} 指定励磁机输出电流限制器增益、{Exciter output current limit reference, I_LR (pu)} 指定励磁机输出电流限制参考值、{Exciter output current limit adjustment, K_CI (pu)} 指定励磁机输出电流限值调整、{Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)} 指定整流器负载系数、{Potential circuit (voltage) gain coefficient, K_P (pu)} 指定电势电路增益系数、{Compound circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I (pu)} 指定电势电路电流增益系数、{Reactance associated with potential source, X_L (pu)} 指定与电势源相关的电抗、{Potential circuit phase angle (degrees)} 指定电势电路相位角、{Maximum available exciter voltage, V_Bmax (pu)} 指定最大可用励磁机磁场电压、{Power source selector} 指定电源选择器 Position A: power source derived from generator terminal，按实例取值。
